## LLM014 ChatMemoryProvider with a hardcoded id

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | LangChain4j |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/多用户共用一份ChatMemory |
| Turn it off | `LLM014: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM014` on the command line |

ChatMemoryProvider hands out memory by id, so a hardcoded id means one session for the whole site: the names and addresses A mentions show up in B's context. This never shows up in load tests; the first complaint after launch comes from a user.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM014` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm014 -->

## What it looks like

A `ChatMemoryProvider` returning memory keyed by `"default"` or any constant string.

## How to fix

Key it by the caller: `id -> MessageWindowChatMemory.withMaxMessages(20)` with an id taken from the request or the conversation.
